copy.headline: Looking for help sorting through Medicare options? A national program offers local guidance
copy.caption:
Through the State Health Insurance Assistance Program, Tarrant County older adults can get free help from benefits counselors. For local seniors who are eligible for Medicare, the options can be overwhelming.

A nationwide program offers free counseling to those who need help sorting through their choices. The Area Agency on Aging of Tarrant County, part of United Way, offers the State Health Insurance Assistance Program locally.

story.title: Looking for help sorting through Medicare options? A national program offers local guidance
story.summary: Through the State Health Insurance Assistance Program, Tarrant County older adults can get free help from benefits counselors. For local seniors who are eligible for Medicare, the options can be overwhelming. A nationwide program offers free counseling to those who need help sorting through their choices. The Area Agency on Aging of Tarrant County, part of United Way, offers the State Health Insurance Assistance Program locally. Tarrant County older adults can get free help from benefits counselors who can answer Medicare policy questions, do plan comparisons and assist with applications for Medicare Savings Programs. The assistance is objective, said Shakita Johnson, chief aging services officer at United Way of Tarrant County. The AAA does not get commissions, kickbacks or incentives, she said.
